name: The Sons of Bostan
storyline:
Kenan steps off the morning bus in Cide, a small town on Turkey's western Black Sea coast. He left years ago and comes back with nothing: no money, no friends he can trust, and a past still waiting at the station. The family that once ruled the town has grown old and divided, and the men around them are waiting for the right moment.

Starting with small favours at the coffeehouse and the harbour, Kenan works his way into the family business. Over 32 chapters the story moves from Cide's bazaar and hidden coves to İnebolu's forests, Amasra's old harbour, the shipyards of Tuzla and the waterside mansions of the Bosphorus. Every deal is made at the dinner table, every loyalty has a price, and the choices Kenan makes decide who he becomes, and who is still standing at the end.
summary: He came home with nothing. The town remembered everything. A crime family saga on the Black Sea coast: Kenan returns to the town of Cide, built from its real map and elevation, and rises through loyalty, deals and betrayals across 32 story chapters. Drive every car, swim in the sea, watch storms roll in, and play online with up to ten players in the same room. Voice acting, interface and subtitles in 16 languages.
